class.name: SteamSocketOffer
class.brief_description: A short-lived request to connect to one specific standalone listener.
class.description: Resolve the offer on the listener that emitted it. It expires after 1.5 seconds and can only be accepted or rejected once. Apply the game's policy before accepting and use the certified account after the connection reports ready.

method.name: get_steam_id
method.description: Returns the initial claimed account, if available.

method.name: get_expires_at_msec
method.description: Returns the expiry in Godot monotonic milliseconds.

members.member: The local route on which the offer arrived.
Steam's initial account claim, or an empty string when unavailable. Read [member SteamSocketConnection.steam_id] after authentication for the certified account.
Expiry using the clock from [method Time.get_ticks_msec].
